valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 57.75 percent a year from FY2022 (2.50144e+09) to FY2026 (1.5491e+10), over 4 years

valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 4.125e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
